clips.noHook.en: No hook text; add one in the campaign
clips.noHook.zh: 没有开场文字，可在广告活动中添加

clips.none.hint.en: Clips are cut automatically a few minutes after an episode video is uploaded: 20–30 second vertical cuts, ready for TikTok or Meta.
clips.none.hint.zh: 分集视频上传后几分钟内会自动切出 20–30 秒的竖版片段，可直接用于 TikTok 或 Meta 广告。

clips.cutting.hint.en: Cutting runs in the background; this list refreshes on its own.
clips.cutting.hint.zh: 正在后台切片，列表会自动刷新。

angles.direct_clip.hint.en: 20–30 second cuts of the drama itself; the hook is the ad's text, nothing is burned into the picture. Each reserves {min} of the budget.
angles.direct_clip.hint.zh: 剧集本身的 20–30 秒直剪；开场文字作为广告文案，不会烧录进画面。每条占用 {min} 预算。

angles.narration.hint.en: A voice tells the story over the footage. Coming soon.
angles.narration.hint.zh: 配音解说剧情。即将推出。

angles.slots.full.en: Slots full. Unselect an ad, or raise the budget in the brief to open more.
angles.slots.full.zh: 名额已满。取消一条广告，或在方案中提高预算以增加名额。

angles.slots.none.en: Set a budget in the brief to open ad slots.
angles.slots.none.zh: 先在方案中设置预算，才有广告名额。

angles.budgetCovers.en: Budget {budget} covers {covers} ads at {min} each · {chosen} chosen
angles.budgetCovers.zh: 预算 {budget} 可投 {covers} 条广告（每条 {min}）· 已选 {chosen} 条

angles.overBudget.en: {chosen} ads chosen but the budget covers {covers}. Unselect {over} or raise the budget in the brief.
angles.overBudget.zh: 已选 {chosen} 条，但预算只够 {covers} 条。请取消 {over} 条，或在方案中提高预算。
